packageRules.description: Workflows run the committed dist/, so every update rebuilds it (postUpgradeTasks) and CI checks it matches a fresh build
@actions/core 3 and @actions/tool-cache 4 onwards are ESM-only, and this action compiles to CommonJS for ncc, so the toolkit's majors wait for a deliberate move to ESM
typescript-eslint 8 supports TypeScript below 6.1, so TypeScript 7 waits until it does
